BiblicalUsage: yᵉphêh-phîyâh is the word the Bible uses when it means very beautiful. In Jeremiah 46:20, Egypt is like a very fair heifer.
TheologicalSignificance: Egypt's beauty is the point of yᵉphêh-phîyâh, and I believe the verse lets it shine only to show how fast it falls.
